question: A and B complete a work in 14 days. If A alone can do it in 42 days, then B alone can do one-third of the same work in _________ (days).
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let total work be the LCM of 14 and 42 = 42 units.

Combined efficiency of A and B = 42 ÷ 14 = 3 units/day.

Efficiency of A alone = 42 ÷ 42 = 1 unit/day.

Efficiency of B alone = 3 − 1 = 2 units/day.

Time taken by B for one-third work = (42 ÷ 3) ÷ 2 = 14 ÷ 2 = 7 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 7 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken by A and B to complete the work = 14 days

Time taken by A alone to complete the work = 42 days

**Calculations:**

 
 

 **Person**
 **Days**
 **Total Work**
 **Efficiency**
 
 

 A + B
 14
 42
 3
 
 

 A
 42
 1
 
 

⇒ Efficiency of B = Efficiency of (A + B) − Efficiency of A

⇒ Efficiency of B = 3 − 1 = 2 units/day

⇒ Target work for B = 1/3 of Total Work

⇒ Target work = (1 ÷ 3) × 42 = 14 units

⇒ Time taken by B = Target work ÷ Efficiency of B

⇒ Time taken by B = 14 ÷ 2 = 7 days

**∴ The correct answer is 7 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Pipes & Cisterns

Works exactly like Time & Work problems. An inlet pipe has a positive efficiency (filling), while an outlet pipe or a leak has a negative efficiency (emptying).

Work & Wages

Wages are always distributed in the ratio of the total work done by each person. If they work for the same number of days, the wages are shared directly in the ratio of their efficiencies.

Alternate Days Work

Find the total work done in a complete cycle (e.g., 2 days for 2 people). Multiply the cycle to get as close to the total work as possible, then calculate the time for the remaining work done by the person whose turn is next.
